column6: This telegram was sent to George E. Q. Johnson detailing Al Capone's activities in Cook County jail after his conviction for income tax evasion.  An official inquiry and investigation was made after this telegram and other information was received.

column5: Letter from William D. Mitchell to George E. Q. Johnson
column6: Attorney General Mitchell wrote this letter to George E.Q. Johnson, Attorney General in Chicago regarding the acceptance of a plea bargain in the income tax evasion case against Al Capone.

column6: U.S. Attorney General George E. Q. Johnson in Chicago crafted this letter to Assistant Attorney General Gustav Aaron Youngquist regarding their meeting to discuss the case against Al Capone.
